transitions.guard: 资产与隔离范围正确且现场依据齐全
transitions.recovery: 不凭网络请求推断现场隔离

transitions.trigger: 维护步骤完成后申请试验
transitions.guard: 必需任务完成、试验获许可
transitions.durable_effect: 保存试验阶段与工作关联
transitions.recovery: 试验失败保持隔离并补任务

transitions.trigger: 负责人接受试运行并交还
transitions.guard: 共享隔离范围所有占用已解除且确认完整
transitions.durable_effect: 保存投运事实与授权人
transitions.recovery: 未知现场结果保持待核实

transitions.guard: 有资产范围权限
transitions.recovery: 重复认领返回已有结果

transitions.guard: 工单范围与异常相关
transitions.durable_effect: 保存 signal/work order 关联
transitions.recovery: 建单未知按操作核对

transitions.guard: 有新的观测与分析理由
transitions.recovery: 工单仍独立继续，不随之关闭

transitions.trigger: 同一未解除episode后续窗口再次命中或超水位回补
transitions.guard: 相同tenant/asset/channel/rule版本；保留事件时间与源修订
transitions.durable_effect: 追加样本依据和必要的复核项，不新建工单
transitions.recovery: 超过两分钟迟到不能自动撤销许可、接受记录或已完成维护

transitions.guard: 范围版本、时间和现场条件获确认
transitions.durable_effect: 保存签发身份与有效期
transitions.recovery: 证据缺失不可推定生效

transitions.guard: 有暂停权限与理由
transitions.durable_effect: 保存新版本并发布通知
transitions.recovery: 活动工单进入待处置；现场停工另确认

transitions.guard: 按服务端时间判定
transitions.recovery: 续工需重新签发或授权修订

transitions.guard: 变化后的范围与现场条件重新确认
transitions.recovery: 不能用旧离线状态恢复

transitions.guard: 所有共享占用解除且负责人确认
transitions.recovery: 未解除占用显示阻塞工单

transitions.guard: 任务、资源、许可前提明确
transitions.recovery: 拒绝保留 proposed 与理由

transitions.guard: 最新许可有效、角色及资产范围匹配
transitions.durable_effect: 原子保存 start operation 与当前许可版本
transitions.recovery: 响应未知查询同 operation

transitions.trigger: 许可暂停或工作条件缺失
transitions.guard: 当前工作受影响
transitions.durable_effect: 保存已完成步骤与阻塞理由
transitions.recovery: 现场负责人处置，不能回滚物理行为

transitions.guard: 新许可/条件获确认且范围已核对
transitions.recovery: 条件未满足保持 blocked

transitions.guard: 必需 booking/任务齐全且证据可读
transitions.recovery: 缺附件不进入接受

transitions.guard: accepted confirmation、完整范围及未决项已处理
transitions.durable_effect: 保存不可无痕改写的关闭证据
transitions.recovery: 重放返回原关闭；错误追加更正和跟进工单

transitions.guard: 尚未开工且有撤销权限
transitions.recovery: 已有执行先核对后采用专门终止流程

transitions.guard: 工单已允许执行且人员匹配
transitions.recovery: 离线状态不刷新许可

transitions.guard: 该 booking 工作证据齐全
transitions.durable_effect: 保存实际时段和完成引用
transitions.recovery: 重复上报不重复工时

transitions.guard: 尚未开始并明确替代/范围变化
transitions.recovery: 不能掩盖必需未完成任务

transitions.guard: 任务、版本、身份、附件摘要齐全
transitions.durable_effect: 保存不可无痕覆盖的提交版本
transitions.recovery: 未知查询 operation；缺文件保持待补充

transitions.guard: 测量、附件、许可适用和任务集合都满足
transitions.recovery: 重试返回原接受

transitions.guard: 说明不符合项及所需补充
transitions.recovery: 新版本补充后重新提交

checks.when: Create W-1, start with current permit, accept both task confirmations and close
checks.then: One S-1 and W-1; three high slots; close references accepted confirmation and permit versions; asset return separately confirmed
checks.evidence_required: Source-minute fixture; operation audit; booking and confirmation IDs; close record and independent asset record

checks.given: Source sample at 09:02 and mobile C-1 already stored
checks.when: Deliver both twice and retry material use operation
checks.then: One effective sample slot, one C-1 and one material use effect
checks.evidence_required: Inbox identities, database unique-key result, material ledger count

checks.given: 09:02 arrives before 09:01; permit v3 suspended, v2 active projection delayed
checks.when: Deliver earlier sample and old permit event
checks.then: Window uses event minutes; current permit remains v3 suspended
checks.evidence_required: Window slot trace; source revisions; authoritative permit vs read model

checks.given: W-1 authorized; technician has permit v2; supervisor suspends it
checks.then: Start either observes valid v2 and later blocks, or rejects with version conflict; no start authorized by stale projection
checks.evidence_required: Transaction ordering, permit versions, explicit start response and affected work queue

checks.given: Tenants A and B each own P-17,W-1,C-1
checks.when: Query list, attachment, cache and operation using the other tenant context
checks.then: No cross-tenant fields or attachment content returned in hit or miss paths
checks.evidence_required: Authorization logs and same-ID fixtures across every read path

checks.given: C-1 persisted and HTTP response lost
checks.when: Mobile retries with same operation ID
checks.then: UI moves from pending verification to original C-1; no second consumption
checks.evidence_required: Durable operation record, lost-response fault injection, effect counts

checks.given: Acceptance saved; close worker crashes before consumption marker
checks.when: Restart worker and replay; separately remove mandatory attachment
checks.then: First closes once; second stays unaccepted/unclosed with specific missing attachment
checks.evidence_required: Crash boundaries, audit sequence, close count, rejected negative fixture

checks.given: G-2 already covers multiple work orders; W-1 completed and W-2 still in_progress, activating the existing shared-scope guard
checks.when: Request return to operation based on W-1
checks.then: Reject return and identify W-2 dependency
checks.evidence_required: Permit scope graph, rejection and independent asset state

checks.given: A=10 B=30 C=20 D=15 minutes; A->B,A->C,B->D,C->D
checks.when: Compute with two then one technician; inject A->B->A cycle
checks.then: Dependency bound 55; one-technician feasible serial duration 75; cycle rejected
checks.evidence_required: Fixed input, topological order, resource occupancy trace and rejection

checks.given: Same tenant/asset/channel/rule has ten consecutive high minutes and one unresolved episode
checks.when: Evaluate all overlapping five-minute windows, then resolve episode and later trigger a fresh window
checks.then: One episode accumulates first run evidence; a new episode is allowed only after prior resolution
checks.evidence_required: Episode business key, matched-window references, explicit resolution and new episode identity

checks.given: A high window caused maintenance already performed; late low revision arrives beyond two-minute watermark
checks.when: Recompute historical signal with source revision
checks.then: Record late correction and human review; preserve prior authorization and execution evidence, no automatic reversal
checks.evidence_required: Event and receive timestamps, watermark, revision trail and unchanged work execution records
